name: WSL / Windows Subsystem for Linux
categoryDescription: Modern Windows artifacts — UWP/AppX packages, OneDrive, and Windows Subsystem for Linux.
description: WSL distribution registration — installed Linux distributions, their install paths, and default distribution.
forensic_value: WSL provides a full Linux environment with access to the Windows filesystem that may evade Windows-focused security controls. Each subkey is a GUID representing an installed distro with its install location. This key only proves a distro is installed — for actual abuse/execution detection, see the companion 'WSL Process Execution & LOLBIN Abuse' artifact in this category.
